answer: Audits are entered in canyon, queued in tundra, and atlas publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 73 identities per epoch. A farm of 121 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4251 identities would post 4896 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
